items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] What was Bricktop, Charlene? Charlene O'Germore? Well, uh, well...

ctx.x: Well, possibly so. And you remember it, though, as being upstairs. Yes, I remember upstairs. Deluxe certainly was upstairs. Deluxe was upstairs. Panama's on the corner, Deluxe next to it. Yes. See, upstairs. See, I remember that. See, so... This was the late Panama that I worked at, 55th, 58th Street, see? So, I never worked with any of those, any of those people. But they knew me, but I never worked with them, see? Was Nettie principally a ballad-type singer? No, I never saw her work in my life. I never saw her…

No, no. She sang a little bit abroad, but not very much. But she sang show tunes and did so much theatrical work. I don't remember specifically that she ever sang blues or didn't. You know, she may have treated it as, I'll sing anything that comes along. Was Bricktop a singer?
What was Bricktop, Charlene? Charlene O'Germore? Well, uh, well...
